topics.title: Variables (let/const), Types & Scopes
topics.objective: Understand block scope, type coercion, template literals, and truthy/falsy evaluations.
topics.exercise: Write an interactive temperature converter that validates numerical input.

topics.title: Arrow Functions, Higher-Order Methods & Closures
topics.objective: Master Array.map, filter, reduce, and lexical this binding.
topics.exercise: Implement a functional shopping cart totalizer calculating discounts and sales tax.

topics.title: DOM Manipulation, Event Delegation & Web APIs
topics.objective: Query and mutate DOM nodes and attach decoupled event listeners to container elements.
topics.exercise: Build an interactive to-do list with real-time task adding, toggling, and removal.

topics.title: Asynchronous Programming (Promises & async/await)
topics.objective: Manage asynchronous operations, handle HTTP fetch calls, and isolate error handling.
topics.example: async function loadData() { const res = await fetch(url); return await res.json(); }
topics.exercise: Create an asynchronous weather forecast widget consuming a public REST endpoint.

topics.title: ES Modules & Modern State Patterns
topics.objective: Decompose application logic using import/export and manage component state in memory.
topics.example: export function calculateTotal(items) { return items.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
topics.exercise: Architect a modular client-side state store with subscribe and dispatch capabilities.
